name: Fee Status Tool Verification
query: What is my current fee status?
description: Agent must call the fee status checker tool and report exact ledger amounts without hallucination.

name: Scholarship Checker Tool Verification
query: What is my scholarship application status?
description: Agent must call the scholarship checker tool and return grant details.

name: Payment Portal Failure Policy RAG
query: The payment portal failed. Can I pay on the next working day?
description: Agent must retrieve policy chunks from the handbook and ground answer on next working day grace policy.

name: Memory Extraction & Storage
query: My preferred name is Rahul and I am studying MBA.
description: Agent must extract and persist non-sensitive student name and programme in SQLite.

name: Session-Independent Memory Retrieval
description: Agent must retrieve saved programme memory from persistent SQLite in a new session without prior chat history.

name: Out-of-Handbook Graceful Admission
query: Tell me the policy for international student hostel refunds.
description: Agent must admit the handbook lacks information on international hostel refunds without inventing policy.

name: Support Ticket Creation Tool
query: I want to raise a support request because my payment is not reflected.
description: Agent must invoke ticket creation tool and generate a persistent ticket ID in SQLite.

name: Direct Answer Without Unnecessary Tools
description: Agent must answer general arithmetic directly without wasteful database or vector queries.

name: Sensitive Information Privacy Filter
description: Agent must strictly reject OTP from long-term memory and never persist sensitive credentials in database.
